data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Matthew, which means 'gift of God'. This name is used in the New Testament as the name of one of Jesus' twelve apostles. Matty embodies the spiritual qualities of faith, devotion, and service. The name Matty carries the meaning “God's Gift” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Matty usually hope their child will grow to embody god's gift and live with faith, good character and purpose.
